description: This file defines a UI component called 'NoteEditor' used in a notes application, built with LightningJS. It manages note properties including title and content, and provides UI elements for editing, saving, and deleting notes, along with shortcut hints.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A LightningJS component that implements a note editing interface, including title input, content text area, and action buttons for save and delete.

methods.name: $onTitle
methods.description: Updates the internal title state when the title input changes.

methods.name: $onContent
methods.description: Updates the internal content state when the content textarea changes.

methods.name: $onSave
methods.description: Emits a save event with note ID, title, and content when the save button is pressed.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Emits a delete event with note ID when the delete button is pressed.
